message:
The packet.o has ASan symbols. The build did complete with ASan. The linking issue is with `bachk` and `str2ba` which are Bluetooth functions. Let me add the bluetooth library:

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gpsd/fuzzer && g++ -fsanitize=address -g -O1 -o FuzzPacket_asan FuzzPacket_asan.o test_main.o -L../gpsd-3.25.1~dev/ -lgpsd -lgps_static -lbluetooth -lm -lrt -lnsl 2>&1</parameter>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
